title: Suede
scene: Early 1990s London alternative rock and pre-Britpop glam revival
notes: Androgynous glam-rock hooks, Butler guitar flourishes, theatrical vocals and urban outsider stories.

title: Dog Man Star
scene: Dark British art-rock and glam with orchestral epics
notes: Dark romanticism, long-form songs, orchestral swells and Butler’s increasingly expansive guitar.

title: Coming Up
scene: Mid-1990s British glam-pop and Britpop chart crossover
notes: Richard Oakes and Neil Codling bring sharper pop hooks, brighter guitars and concise choruses.

title: Head Music
scene: Late-1990s British glam-pop incorporating electronic studio rhythms
notes: Steve Osborne introduces drum-machine-driven songwriting, synth textures and a slicker groove.
